DateWire.description: ISO 8601 calendar date encoded as a `YYYY-MM-DD` JSON string.

description: Drawdown episode with start, valley, optional recovery, and max drawdown.

duration_days.description: Calendar days from peak to recovery, or last observation when open.

end.description: First observed recovery to zero drawdown; absent for an open episode.

max_drawdown.description: Signed decimal peak-to-valley loss in the closed interval `[-1, 0)`.

start.description: Actual valuation date of the peak immediately preceding the decline.

valley.description: First actual observation attaining the deepest loss in the episode.

title: DrawdownEpisode
